title: Record migration-first SQLite schema policy
description:
Write the design note or ADR for Eshyra's migration-first SQLite schema policy before implementation.

The decision should settle:
- SQL migration files are the canonical executable schema source.
- Whether schema.snapshot.sql exists and whether it is generated-only.
- How schema_migrations records version, name, checksum, and applied_at.
- Transaction policy for migrations.
- How bootstrap/default rows are handled without becoming hidden schema repair.
- How old meta.schema_version databases are adopted or rejected.
- What developers must do when changing schema after this lands.

Acceptance criteria:
- A committed design note or ADR describes the migration-first policy.
- The note explicitly rejects hand-maintained latest-schema DDL as executable authority.
- The note describes the chosen legacy DB behavior.
- The note includes enough workflow detail for future agent/coding sessions to add migrations correctly.
close_reason: ADR 0015 (migration-first SQLite schema policy) written and delivered in PR #315. Settles all decision points: SQL files as sole schema authority, schema_migrations ledger, SHA-256 checksum drift policy, per-migration transactions, seed-as-migration, legacy adoption-at-15-vs-reset, generated-only snapshot, and the future-migration authoring workflow. Implementation is .1.3-.1.7.
